message:
🚀 Flex GUI Pro — Version 6.0.3 Official Release Notes
Introducing the highly anticipated Proximity Effector System animation engine alongside robust asset pipeline performance upgrades, shape gradient locking workflows, and enhanced system installers.

⭐ The Proximity Effector System (New Animation Engine)
Added a complete dynamic animation engine allowing layers to automatically animate (scale, move, fade, rotate, or wiggle) based on their real-time spatial distance to a control Null layer.

Proximity "+ ADD NULL" Tool: Added an automated UI button next to the target dropdown to instantly spawn a clean, unparented Null layer programmatically mapped to selected layers.

Interactive Layer FX Catalog Controls: Added inline action controls to the Layer FX list. You can now toggle active states (👁), delete individual effects (✕), or batch clear the entire list with a new "Remove All" favorites bar button.

Proximity "Remove Expressions" Utility: Added a dedicated footer action button to instantly strip all proximity expressions and mathematical links from selected layers.

Windows System-Wide Installer Script: Added Install_FlexGUI_Pro.bat to handle administrative permissions, power-shell extraction, clearing of duplicate user folder overrides, and setting target registry debug values.

🔧 ENHANCEMENTS & COMPATIBILITY
🎨 Shape Layer Gradient Locking (AE 2026)
Extended fxLock capability to support locking native Shape Layer Gradient Fills (G-Fill) and Gradient Strokes (G-Stroke) directly to local shape bounds.

📦 Production Release Separations & Signing
Partitioned builds into unsecured/ (raw source backup) and secured/ (obfuscated binaries only) folders.

Signed the production package to flexv6.0.3 build-1.zxp using the Adobe packaging tool and secure timestamp authorities.

🪲 BUG FIXES & STABILITY
🚫 Auto-Relinker Scan Hang Prevention
Capped folder recursion limits to 5000 files and excluded system/hidden directories (like $Recycle.Bin) to prevent panel freezes. Wrapped operations in Try/Catch modules to bypass unsupported file paths.

All core ExtendScript library dependencies, HTML signatures, and internal line verification hashes have been systematically updated and validated for stable deployment.
